notes.title: Voice Acting Added
notes.content:
This update has added voice acting.

Catz, Kitsune, Okami, Lilith Bloodrose, and General Bastardo now has most of their lines voice acted.

The graveyard no longer have surprise late game enemies player is clearly not prepared to fight at that point of the story. It also should now be contained so NPC characters can't wander in or out.

Some minor fixes/changes.

The old version will be added to the beta branch in a case someone prefers characters not to talk, audibly.

notes.title: New Content Out Now!
notes.content:
I have kept working with the game, fixing bugs and doing improvements with cooperation of various developers. Now that's taken care of, it's time to start bringing out more free content!

Accessory department was quite lacking in this game so I added bunch of new accessories that can be bought via the Vendor Machines. This includes stuff like Credits Pouch that doubles the party's Credits gain from the battles.

While the game boasts already a great monster variation per area, I added even more monsters that are randomly picked to battle against you in the specific areas (visible encounters.)

Icon variation has been also improved. It allows you more easily distinguish items from each-other without reading their names.

Final puzzle has been made a bit easier as solving it under a minute was already a quite the challenge.

I will keep adding even more free content to the base product. This includes even more different monsters, items, etc. Also more optional areas might be added.

notes.title: Upcoming Stuff
notes.content:
One of the things that are coming with a major update will be that all the playable characters will have voice acting along with their dialogue.

And yes, it's a real deal, I have heard a lot of it and I can say it will sound good.

Another guy is working on getting it all finished and then I put them into the game. Each playable character has their own voice actors which adds a lot of diversity to their voices.

In terms of DLC, there should be some. Thanks to all the buyers so far, I can properly fix the game and bring you additional story related content.

THANK YOU FOR BUYING THE GAME! :)
